statusDefinitions.implemented_unverified: Code exists, but required tests/readback incomplete.
statusDefinitions.tested: All stated acceptance tests have evidence; distinguish source and physical runtime.
statusDefinitions.blocked: Dependency or objective failure prevents this task.

sourceOfTruth: Real runtime scene and existing editor transactions; no parallel simulated preview

gates.release: Only objective broken build, launch, essential gameplay, required multiplayer or updater function may block release. Art and diagnostics are advisory.
gates.security: No listener is opened by the trusted local service/CLI; the process retains normal user file permissions. Later remote interfaces require explicit opt-in, authentication and scoped capabilities; no arbitrary shell/filesystem or player-session surface.
gates.completion: Do not count draft documentation, unpublished blobs, packaging, or missing real installed runtime as completed machine access.
